arguments.sql: SELECT id, amount_usd_cents / 100.0 AS amount_usd FROM transactions ORDER BY amount_usd_cents DESC, id ASC LIMIT 5
arguments.explanation: Returns the five transactions with the largest amounts, showing each transaction id and its amount in dollars, largest first.
assumptions: "Largest" means the highest signed amount, so negative amounts rank lowest. It does not mean the largest absolute value.
When two amounts are equal, the lower transaction id is listed first.
